_note: Which labels a consumer actually reads, for the coverage check (appearance.md Decision 10). Committed config, frozen like eval/vocab.json -- deliberately NOT a lookup into a live consumer's configuration, so a coverage number is reproducible across machines and time. This file is the one place in the repo where label names are written down, and it is config, never code: folk's own source contains no label name anywhere (Decision 2).

dream.description: The dream toolkit's figure: clause. It reads the flattened brief today; these are the labels a figure needs for that clause to hold a person together across frames.
